fields.name: id
fields.description: Opaque, stable identifier of the source: the first twelve hex digits of a hash of its normalised address and the archive timestamp. The normalised address keeps the fragment of a GitHub comment or review, which is a source of its own, and reduces a Google Doc to its document id.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: What kind of source it is.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The title of the source as a reader sees it.

fields.name: date
fields.description: The date the source speaks for: the date of the conference for a conference page; else, for an archived copy, the day of its capture; else the date the source shows, which the capture takes even when it is a placeholder such as 2000-01-01; else the day it was fetched. A wrong date is corrected by hand when there is evidence for the right one, cited in `notes`.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The address of the source on the web.

fields.name: archive_url
fields.description: The address of the Wayback Machine copy that was read, if one was.

fields.name: fetched
fields.description: When the source was read, in UTC.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Anything a reader of the source needs to know.
